purpose: Establish one authoritative continuity checkpoint after Hero page work was interrupted and resumed across multiple work sessions. This audit does not reopen frozen semantics; it verifies that interrupted work was absorbed by later final gates and that production consumers use frozen generated relations instead of re-deriving ConfigData joins.

authority.rule: When older chat/progress notes conflict with this audit or the cited final checkpoints, prefer the final repository checkpoints.

scope: Stage 6 normalized composition, representative QA, full 267-Hero generation, and final site-consumer contract

stage1_2.note: The historical 1-2 session boundary is not preserved as a standalone modern final checkpoint. Its canonical output is nevertheless transitively revalidated: the canonical Hero population is 267, Stage 3 automatic validation passes, every Stage 4/5 block preserves 267, and Stage 6-4 freezes 267 usable Hero shards with zero hard errors. No evidence requires reopening Stage 1-2.

stage5_5_2.note: The only retained gap is source-omitted acquisition metadata for 176 regular skins; it is explicitly non-blocking and is not a continuity or semantic defect.

antiDuplicateJoinRules.heroSoldier: Consume the frozen byHero relation/index; do not recalculate membership from ConfigData.
antiDuplicateJoinRules.heroExclusiveEquipment: Consume Stage B byHeroId for production ownership; do not reread SkillHero in page/frontend code.
antiDuplicateJoinRules.skin: Preserve frozen Hero Stage 5-5 ownership/order; missing acquisition source fields remain explicit UNENCODED rather than inferred.

nonBlockingReviews: 41 referenced Soldier records retain pending/missing Korean presentation names.
176 regular skins retain UNENCODED acquisition because source GetPathType is omitted.
Some CV/faction/origin/skin Korean localization remains presentation-layer follow-up.

reopenPolicy: Do not reopen Stage 1-5, Hero-Soldier relation semantics, or Hero-exclusive Equipment ownership because of old chat discontinuity alone. Reopen only when a new source snapshot, an explicit contradiction, or a failing regression check identifies the owning stage.
decision: No continuity defect was found that justifies redoing interrupted Hero work. The current authoritative start point is the frozen Stage 6-4 site-consumer contract, with remaining work limited to presentation metadata, assets, and frontend/UI integration unless new evidence invalidates an owning checkpoint.
